snippet.title: VectaGuard: Zero - Announce Trailer
snippet.description:
VectaGuard: Zero 

Inspired by retro shmups like Caverns of Mars, Fort Apocalypse, Gravitar and many others, VectaGuard: Zero is an arcade-inspired shmup action where neon vector caverns explode with modern visuals, dynamic music, weapon upgrades and intense score chasing.

Coming Soon for PC, SteamDeck and Atari VCS.
WISHLIST: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2892200/VectaGuard_Zero/

More Info and Games: https://www.retroninja.com/
